name: VC_Manhole_Round_A
pivot: centre of the cover at the ROAD SURFACE (z = 0); the casting sits -0.062 m deep
notes: 0.62 m round cast cover in a 0.80 m frame, concentric-ring pattern with a centre boss and two lift slots. Cover top +10 mm, frame top +6 mm, rim tapers to the road plane.

name: VC_Manhole_Round_B
pivot: centre of the cover at the ROAD SURFACE (z = 0); the casting sits -0.062 m deep
notes: 0.62 m round cast cover in a 0.80 m frame, 16 radial ribs inside a perimeter ring with a centre boss and one lift slot. Same flush profile as pattern A, so the two read as different castings in the same frame.

name: VC_UtilityCover_Square
pivot: centre of the cover at the ROAD SURFACE (z = 0)
notes: 0.60 m square utility access cover in a 0.72 m frame, chequer studs and two lift slots. Cover top +10 mm, frame top +6 mm.

name: VC_StormDrain_Grate_Road
pivot: centre of the grate at the ROAD SURFACE (z = 0)
notes: 0.58 m in-carriageway storm grate in a 0.70 m frame: 7 bars recessed 10 mm under the frame top, two cross ribs, a sump floor 90 mm down. The collider is a single flush plate so wheels roll over the bars instead of dropping in.

name: VC_ExpansionJoint_Strip_4m
pivot: start of the piece, joint centreline, z = 0 = road surface
notes: 4.00 m transverse/longitudinal joint strip, 0.30 m wide: a 52 mm groove with a sealant bead whose top sits 2 mm below the road. Ships with NO collider: its top face would be exactly coplanar with the road collider and put the wheel raycast in a tie. The road beneath carries surface and height.
